description: Checkbox — the control, and only the control. The glyph IS an icon from the EDS set (as EDS 1.x rendered it), rendered as a MASK on the native input itself (appearance: none; background-color is the ink - the CSS twin of the Figma mask+tint) and swapped by the platform's own :checked. One element, no wrapper, native focus/keyboard/forms behaviour. Interactive green in both states (EDS 1.0 — Victor, 2026-08-29). Labelled rows are COMPOSITION.
notes: Selection-control colour history (Victor, 2026-08-29): EDS 2.0 planned neutral-at-rest -> accent-when-checked to reduce accent usage; EDS 1.0 is green in both states — going with 1.0 for now, one token flip per state to revisit. The control glyph footprint is the md cap box, so a control beside an md label sits on the text's cap like any other glyph. REFUSED for now: the EDS 1.x radial hover halo. Indeterminate PROMOTED from refusal (v0.2.0, 2026-08-30 polish): a third pseudo-bound enum value — the platform pseudo :indeterminate swaps the mask to checkbox_indeterminate; it is JS-set and may coexist with :checked, so it is emitted last and wins the cascade. The focus ring is a 4-way drop-shadow filter: a mask clips the outline (measured in Chrome, 2026-08-29), and filters apply AFTER masking - the ring hugs the glyph.

props.name: checked
props.description: The platform's own state — :checked / :indeterminate in CSS, a variant axis in Figma. Indeterminate is JS-set (no HTML attribute) and can coexist with checkedness; the CSS emits it last so it wins.

aria.type: the control is <input type="checkbox">; checkedness is the platform's, reflected by :checked
